scope: Manual or isolated-fixture acceptance scripts; no actions are executed by this file.

zh.task: 在24条消息窗口底部，收到第25条回复。
zh.expected: 对话容器跟随最后turn_id；页顶和其他面板不被滚动。

en.task: Stay at the bottom of a 24-message window and receive reply 25.
en.expected: The conversation follows the latest turn ID without scrolling the page or other panels.

zh.task: 上翻阅读旧消息，再收到两条回复。
zh.expected: 不强拉到底部；显示新回复入口。

en.task: Scroll up to read earlier messages, then receive two replies.
en.expected: Do not jump to the bottom; show the new-reply entry.

zh.task: 存在未读新回复时点击“查看最新”。
zh.expected: 滚动对话到底部，入口消失，后续回复继续跟随。

en.task: With a new reply pending, select Jump to latest.
en.expected: Scroll the conversation to the bottom, clear the entry, and follow subsequent replies.

zh.task: 出现新回复入口后，手动滚到距底部48像素内。
zh.expected: 入口清除，后续新增回复正常跟随。

en.task: After the new-reply entry appears, manually scroll within 48 pixels of the bottom.
en.expected: Clear the entry and follow subsequent replies.

zh.task: 上翻后等待多次相同状态轮询。
zh.expected: 不发生自动滚动或虚假新回复提示。

en.task: Scroll up and wait for repeated identical state polls.
en.expected: Do not auto-scroll or show a false new-reply notification.

zh.task: 从有24条消息的档案切换到另一个同样有24条消息的档案。
zh.expected: 新会话从最新内容开始，旧未读提示清除，档案数据隔离。

en.task: Switch from a profile with 24 messages to another profile with 24 messages.
en.expected: Start at the latest content in the new session, clear the old indicator, and keep profiles isolated.

zh.task: 切换到没有对话的新活动。
zh.expected: 显示空态，不保留旧滚动提示。

en.task: Switch to a new activity with no conversation.
en.expected: Show the empty state without retaining an old scroll indicator.

zh.task: 开启预览并连续输入一段中英文问题。
zh.expected: 预览独立刷新；输入内容、焦点、教师报告草稿保持。

en.task: Run the preview while typing a question containing Chinese and English.
en.expected: Refresh the preview independently while preserving text, focus, and the teacher report draft.

zh.task: 在原图和镜像间切换后点选同一人脸框。
zh.expected: 图像与框使用同一快照；坐标镜像只影响显示，选中key不改变。

en.task: Toggle original and mirrored views, then select the same face box.
en.expected: Image and boxes use one snapshot; mirroring affects display coordinates, not the selected key.

zh.task: 明确点选一张脸，观察档案与跟随开关。
zh.expected: 只选择临时目标；不换档案、不自动开启物理跟随。

en.task: Select a face explicitly and inspect the learner profile and follow control.
en.expected: Select only the temporary target; do not switch profiles or enable physical following.

zh.task: 清除选中目标，此时最近状态轮询仍含旧key。
zh.expected: 帧中的null选择优先；旧状态不能重新显示为已选择。

en.task: Clear the selected target while the latest state poll still contains its old key.
en.expected: The frame null selection wins; stale state must not restore the selection.

zh.task: 有画面请求尚未返回时关闭摄像头。
zh.expected: 立即清空画面；迟到旧响应不能恢复旧图或框；最多一个画面请求。

en.task: Close the camera while a frame request is still pending.
en.expected: Clear the preview; a late response cannot restore old pixels or boxes; keep at most one frame request.

zh.task: 关闭后重新开启，令相机epoch变化。
zh.expected: 旧epoch帧与目标不可复活，新的目标须重新选择。

en.task: Close and reopen the camera so its epoch changes.
en.expected: Old-epoch frames and targets cannot revive; select a new target explicitly.

zh.task: 用隔离fixture模拟画面接口认证错误或断开。
zh.expected: 隐藏旧图和框，显示错误；不绕过认证、不自动用旧图伪装直播。

en.task: Use an isolated fixture to return an authentication error or disconnect the frame endpoint.
en.expected: Hide old pixels and boxes and show the error; do not bypass authentication or present stale footage as live.

zh.task: 用fixture依次返回关闭、连接中、有效直播状态。
zh.expected: 请求间隔分别1000/250/33ms；以请求完成为起点，不并发积压。

en.task: Use a fixture to return closed, opening, and live states in sequence.
en.expected: Use 1000/250/33 ms intervals after completion, without overlapping requests.

zh.task: 用fixture展示PAUSED、ARMING和STOPPING状态。
zh.expected: 停止入口保持可用；不实际发送设备命令。

en.task: Use a fixture to show PAUSED, ARMING, and STOPPING states.
en.expected: Keep Stop available; this scripted fixture does not send physical commands.

zh.task: 中文提问“测距模块为什么能帮助停车？”，再选择英文教学提出同义问题。
zh.expected: 教学语言按设置；明确摄像头不验证模块连接，不把建议当已完成实验。

en.task: Ask why a distance module helps stopping in Chinese, then ask the equivalent question with English teaching selected.
en.expected: Use the selected teaching language; do not treat camera observations as module verification or suggestions as completed experiments.

zh.task: 发送后立即编辑下一条问题，并令旧发送请求失败。
zh.expected: 保留新草稿；失败信息可见。

en.task: Edit a new question immediately after sending, then fail the earlier send request.
en.expected: Preserve the newer draft and expose the failure.

zh.task: 填入教师观察“第二次间隙更大”，直接结束并保存。
zh.expected: 先保存观察再结束；来源保留，模块未勾选变更时不被清空。

en.task: Enter the teacher observation The second gap was larger, then finish and save.
en.expected: Save the observation before finishing; retain provenance and leave unchanged module selections intact.

zh.task: 生成过程中停止，再切换档案并继续输入。
zh.expected: 旧回执、旧自动播报与旧滚动提示不进入新档案。

en.task: Stop during generation, switch profiles, and continue typing.
en.expected: Keep old responses, old automatic speech, and old scroll indicators out of the new profile.

zh.task: 将界面设为English，教学语言保持中文，再发送中文问题。
zh.expected: 界面关键操作显示英文，教学回复继续按中文设置；已有报告和档案名称不被翻译。

en.task: Set the interface to English, keep the teaching language Chinese, and send a Chinese question.
en.expected: Key interface actions use English while teaching remains Chinese; existing reports and profile names stay verbatim.

zh.task: 分别选择短句、常规说明、术语表达，保持提示方式不变。
zh.expected: 每次只提交reading_level；帮助方式不被覆盖，不新增年龄或能力推断字段。

en.task: Select plain, standard and technical reading styles while leaving guidance style unchanged.
en.expected: Send only reading_level for each change; preserve guidance style and add no inferred age or ability fields.

zh.task: 生成教学回复时只调整朗读语速；录音时只切换界面语言。
zh.expected: 语速变更不取消文字生成；界面语言不失效当前录音/转写票据。

en.task: Change only speech speed during generation; change only interface language during recording.
en.expected: Speech speed does not cancel text generation; interface language does not invalidate recording/transcription tickets.

zh.task: 在隔离fixture返回缺少新偏好字段的旧状态，再返回已保存偏好。
zh.expected: 旧状态默认界面中文、常规阅读、正常语速；有字段后按保存值显示。

en.task: Return older state without the new preference fields in an isolated fixture, then return saved preferences.
en.expected: Default to Chinese interface, standard reading and normal speed for older state; show persisted values when present.

zh.task: 保存界面英文与档案偏好，重载界面并在两个档案间切换。
zh.expected: 界面语言保持工作台设置；教学语言、阅读表达、帮助方式和语速跟随各自档案。

en.task: Save English interface and learner preferences, reload the page, and switch between profiles.
en.expected: Interface language stays workstation-wide; teaching language, reading style, guidance and speech speed follow each profile.

zh.task: 在隔离状态中让档案提示方式为guided、本次偏好为one_step；查看教师设置并点击恢复档案提示方式。
zh.expected: 同时明确显示档案适量提示与本次一次一步；恢复只提交help_style=guided，服务端清空本次偏好后提示块消失，其他偏好和输入草稿保留。

en.task: Use isolated state with guided profile guidance and a one_step activity preference; inspect teacher settings and restore profile guidance.
en.expected: Clearly show Guided hints for the profile and One step at a time for this activity; restore sends only help_style=guided. Hide the notice after the server clears activity preferences; preserve other preferences and input drafts.

zh.task: 本次偏好只有explicit_request，内容为“发送”或中英混合多行原话，切换界面语言。
zh.expected: 仍显示本次活动偏好及恢复入口；原话不被当作界面文案翻译，换行保留，不凭空显示一次一步。空偏好对象不显示提示块。

en.task: Provide only explicit_request in activity preferences, using “发送” or a multiline bilingual request; switch interface language.
en.expected: Keep the activity-preference notice and restore action. Preserve the request verbatim and its line breaks, without inventing a one-step style. An empty preference object shows no notice.
